title: AI & Automation
completion_message: ¡Excelente! La Inteligencia Artificial es la próxima revolución industrial. Conocer términos como 'Machine learning', 'Algorithm bias' y 'Disruption' te permite liderar la transformación digital en cualquier empresa.

parts.visual:
La Inteligencia Artificial (AI) está transformando el trabajo corporativo. 

1. Machine learning (Aprendizaje automático): 
- Cuando las computadoras aprenden de los datos sin ser programadas explícitamente. 
Ej: Our fraud detection system uses MACHINE LEARNING. 

2. Algorithm bias (Sesgo algorítmico): 
- Cuando la IA toma decisiones injustas o discriminatorias porque fue entrenada con datos sesgados. 
Ej: We must fix the ALGORITHM BIAS in our hiring software. 

3. Disruption (Disrupción): 
- Cuando una nueva tecnología destruye la forma antigua de hacer negocios. 
Ej: AI is causing massive DISRUPTION in the legal industry.
parts.audio: Welcome to AI and Automation in Business. Artificial Intelligence is transforming corporate work. Let's cover the essential vocabulary. Number 1: Machine learning. This is when computers learn from data without being explicitly programmed. For example: Our fraud detection system uses MACHINE LEARNING. Number 2: Algorithm bias. When an AI makes unfair or discriminatory decisions because it was trained on biased human data. For example: We must fix the ALGORITHM BIAS in our hiring software. Number 3: Disruption. When a new technology completely changes or destroys the old way of doing business. For example: AI is causing massive DISRUPTION in the legal industry.

parts.visual:
4. Automation (Automatización): 
- Usar tecnología para hacer tareas humanas. 
Ej: Robotic process AUTOMATION will save us millions. 

5. Scalability (Escalabilidad): 
- La capacidad de un sistema para crecer y manejar más demanda sin colapsar. 
Ej: The cloud infrastructure offers infinite SCALABILITY. 

6. Data mining (Minería de datos): 
- Analizar bases de datos enormes para encontrar patrones ocultos. 
Ej: Through DATA MINING, we discovered what teenagers really buy. 

7. Redundancy (Redundancia / Despidos por automatización): 
- En RRHH, significa despedir a alguien porque su trabajo ya no es necesario (frecuentemente por la IA). 
Ej: The new software will lead to 500 REDUNDANCIES.
parts.audio: Number 4: Automation. The use of technology to perform tasks without human intervention. For example: Robotic process AUTOMATION will save us millions. Number 5: Scalability. The capacity of a system to grow and handle increased demand without failing. For example: The cloud infrastructure offers infinite SCALABILITY. Number 6: Data mining. Analyzing massive databases to discover hidden patterns. For example: Through DATA MINING, we discovered what teenagers really buy. Number 7: Redundancy. In Human Resources, making someone 'redundant' means firing them because their job is no longer needed, often due to AI or automation. For example: The new software will lead to 500 REDUNDANCIES.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el término tecnológico o corporativo correcto.

questions.question: Instead of writing fixed rules, we use ____ learning so the software improves itself over time. (Aprendizaje automático).
The AI recruiting tool was rejecting female applicants because of a historical ____ in its training data. (Sesgo/Prejuicio).
questions.explanation: Algorithm bias = sesgo o prejuicio en el algoritmo.

questions.question: Uber caused massive ____ in the traditional taxi industry. (Disrupción / Alteración drástica).
questions.explanation: Disruption = disrupción (innovación que cambia el mercado).

questions.question: By using robotic process ____, we can process invoices 100 times faster without humans. (Automatización).
We need a database with high ____ so it doesn't crash when we go from 10,000 to 1 million users. (Escalabilidad).
They hired data scientists to perform data ____ on our customer records to find hidden buying patterns. (Minería de datos).
Because the new AI can do the work of 10 accountants, the company announced 500 ____. (Despidos por redundancia).
questions.explanation: Redundancies = despidos corporativos (porque el puesto ya no hace falta).

questions.question: A type of AI that can create new text, images, or code (like ChatGPT) is called ____ AI. (Generativa).
The massive volume of structured and unstructured data generated daily by businesses is called ____ Data.
A computer program designed to simulate conversation with human users, especially over the internet, is a ____. (Chatbot).
When an AI hallucinates or makes up fake information but presents it as a fact, it is called a ____. (Alucinación).
questions.explanation: AI Hallucination = cuando la IA inventa respuestas.

questions.question: Using AI to analyze historical data and forecast future trends or customer behavior is called ____ analytics. (Predictivo).
Technology that can recognize and understand human speech is Natural ____ Processing (NLP).
questions.explanation: Natural Language Processing (NLP) = Procesamiento de Lenguaje Natural.

questions.question: A system where machines are connected to the internet and can communicate with each other (like smart thermostats) is the Internet of ____ (IoT).
questions.explanation: Internet of Things (IoT) = Internet de las Cosas.

questions.question: In tech startups, completely changing the company's business model to survive is called a ____. (Pivotar/Cambio de dirección).
An early sample or model built to test a concept or process is a ____. (Prototipo).
The initial launch of a product to a limited audience to test it before the full public release is a ____ launch.
questions.explanation: Soft launch = lanzamiento suave o de prueba.

questions.question: Software that is provided over the internet on a subscription basis (like Salesforce or Netflix) is called ____ (Software as a Service).
When old, outdated computer systems are still being used because replacing them is too hard, they are called ____ systems. (Sistemas heredados).
To write the instructions or text that guide an AI like ChatGPT to produce a desired output is called ____ engineering.
questions.explanation: Prompt engineering = ingeniería de instrucciones para IA.

questions.question: ____ learning. (Aprendizaje automático con M)
Algorithm ____. (Sesgo/prejuicio con B)
Industry ____. (Disrupción con D)
Process ____. (Automatización con A)
Infinite ____. (Escalabilidad con S)
Data ____. (Minería de datos con M)
Job ____. (Despidos por automatización con R)
____ AI. (IA Generativa con G)
____ analytics. (Análisis predictivo con P)
____ engineering. (Ingeniería de textos para IA con P)

Búsqueda de patrones en grandes datos
Despidos porque el trabajo ya no es necesario
Usar datos para predecir el futuro
